description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeysTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeys-related functionality in a media server context. It includes mock object initialization, creation and destruction of media keys, and session management methods.

classes.name: MediaKeysTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media keys testing, providing setup and utility functions for creating and destroying media keys and sessions.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::MediaKeysTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys with a specified key system, setting up necessary mocks and expectations.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys the media keys instance, unregistering the client and cleaning up.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session for a given key system.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets up an expectation that a task will be enqueued and executed immediately on the main thread.
